thread:
Asha (PM): Morning team — quick async standup for the product launch window. What I did: finalized launch checklist, legal confirmed data retention policy. Blockers: still waiting on the dedicated pool smoke tests. Today: coordinate canary, finalize release notes, confirm API defaults. Miguel — any update on the quantization PR?

Miguel: pushed draft PR #482 this morning -> needs runtime review. Current blocker: integration tests failing with long-context batches. Failing log snippet: ```AssertionError: expected latency_ms < 100 but got 123.45``` Will add more unit tests today.

Kevin: grabbing the PR for review now, will leave comments by EOD. Small suggestion: rename `BatchingConfig` -> `BatchConfig` to match naming in other modules. :+1:

Sana: infra update — spun up a small dedicated pool for canary, capacity looks OK for low traffic. Canary scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PST. Also seeing a regression in embedding latency on one workload, investigating root cause.

Olga: skimmed the API spec — the `max_tokens` default isn't documented in the schema. Added inline comment in the spec doc asking to confirm default. PM, please confirm intended default so docs and SDKs match.

Asha (PM): confirm `max_tokens` default should be `1024` (matches previous releases). Please add to release notes and SDK changelog. @Miguel can you add a test for max_tokens edge cases?

Miguel: will add tests. Quick question — should the canary include the q4 quantized variant or just float16?

Sana: canary plan: run both float16 and q4 variants. Routing rule: prefer float16 for latency-sensitive traffic, fallback to q4 when float16 pool is saturated. I'll publish the exact routing policy in the infra thread.

Kevin: FYI design filed a tiny UX change for the model selection toggle — link in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz — needs a quick dev review before we freeze the UI for the launch.

Olga: I'll take the docs and API note after the PR review lands. Also added a short snippet for the SDK example showing `max_tokens: 1024`.

Asha (PM): TL;DR: blockers = Miguel's integration tests, Sana's perf investigation. Action items: Kevin to review PR, Miguel to add tests and address integration failures, Sana to post perf numbers in infra thread, Olga to update API docs and SDK examples. Ping me if anything else blocks the Tuesday canary. :thumbsup:
